data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'udda, meaning to guide or help. In Islamic tradition, Muiddah refers to a guide or helper in spiritual matters, often a teacher or mentor. The name Muiddah carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muiddah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
